description: This file defines an AuthMiddleware class implementing PSR middleware for JWT authentication and authorization, handling token extraction, validation, and user role assignment.

classes.name: AuthMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware class for handling JWT authentication, token validation, and user role assignment in HTTP requests.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies: UserRepository, KeycloakService, LoggerInterface, ApplicationConfig.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method to process incoming requests, extract and validate JWT, assign user info, handle exceptions.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Extracts JWT token from query parameters or Authorization header, throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: extractRoleFromToken
methods.description: Determines user role from token's resource_access or realm_access fields.
